title: Create an item
description: A guided item proposal: choose a baseline, write its story, select sprites and bonuses, then download it for review.
note: Nine gear slots; proposals are reviewed before inclusion.

title: Sprite editor
description: Draw or edit a 32 × 32 inventory icon and character sprite, starting from game art or a blank canvas, then send both to the item wizard.
note: Custom sprites travel inside the item proposal and are reviewed before inclusion.

title: Item editor
description: Edit every gear item: identity, sprites, base stats, drops, built-in bonuses and random affix pools. Imports player proposals.
note: Reads items.json directly and downloads it byte-exact. Replace project/data/items.json with the download, then run python3 tools/sync_manifests_from_items_json.py.

title: Tile atlas
description: Browse the DCSS source art by category, biome and filename.
note: The atlas includes source art that is not shipped. The item wizard only offers shipped sprites.

title: Biome appearance
description: Edit tile pools, lighting, enemies and biome metadata.
note: Archived 2026-10-27 at the developer’s request. Preserved as a historical reference; this tool is no longer maintained.

title: Item bonuses
description: Edit affix curves. Opens on the affixes that can roll; parked ones sit behind a filter.
note: Exports require review against the runtime; this editor cannot implement new mechanics.

title: Enchant combos
description: Browse the seven enchant flavours and their 21 combos.
note: Read-only; effects live in the game code.

title: Drop rates
description: Developer tuning for ordinary loot chance, quality, enchant and tint settings.
note: Archived 2026-10-27 at the developer’s request. Preserved as a historical reference; this tool is no longer maintained.

title: Enemy resistances
description: Edit current enemy resistance values and export the complete document.
note: Reads the current enemies.json. Changes still need combat testing.

title: Spell data reference
description: Explore current spell archetypes, names and eligible affixes.
note: Archived 2026-10-27 at the developer’s request. Preserved as a historical reference; this tool is no longer maintained.

title: Tooltip layout study
description: Completed design study, superseded by the in-game Tooltip Lab and current item cards.
note: Archived 2026-10-27. Historical mockups; not the current tooltip renderer.

title: Equipment slot proposal
description: Historical equipment expansion research. The current game has nine gear slots and five spell slots.
note: Archived 2026-10-27. Proposal scores and recommendations describe an earlier game.

title: Performance audit · July 2026
description: Dated measurements and findings from the 2026-07-01 audit.
note: Archived 2026-10-27. Historical measurements; run the benchmark harness for current performance.

title: Item roll flowchart
description: Historical roll and tooltip visualisation, including active Primal drop claims that no longer apply.
note: Archived 2026-10-27. Predates Descent Eternal rewards and current tooltip rendering. Do not use its odds as current tuning.

title: Build viability study
description: Earlier species and spell build heuristics with hand-maintained assumptions.
note: Archived 2026-10-27. Viability labels are historical estimates; use deterministic duel or playthrough harnesses for current balance.

title: Reaction design chart
description: Embedded spell-combo design table from the earlier combat plan.
note: Archived 2026-10-27. Historical design reference, not generated from the current reaction engine. Verify reactions in game or with the combo harness.
